summary: RETEST after iteration_1 fixes. Backend: 30/30 pytest passing (100%). All 5 review-spec API checks pass: GET /api/mobility/traffic → provider azure_maps; POST /api/mobility/route → provider azure_maps with duration_traffic_s=1295; GET /api/mobility/anti-congestion as owner (pro) → 200 with options[] & recommendations[]; as ana.demo (free) → 402 PLAN_UNAVAILABLE {title:'NO DISPONIBLE EN EL PLAN ACTUAL'}; POST /api/meetings with place_query 'Puerta del Sol Madrid' → destination.provider=azure_maps and destination_state='ok'. Frontend: all 4 flows in the retest list PASS. Login as ana.demo lands on /map, page reload persists /map. Sentinel Orb opens full-screen orb-scene with 7 orb-family-* nodes. orb-family-coordinacion expands orb-tool-quedar + orb-tool-convoy; tapping again collapses. orb-family-movilidad → orb-tool-anti_congestion → unavailable-sheet titled 'NO DISPONIBLE EN EL PLAN ACTUAL' → unavailable-upgrade-button → /plans (plans-screen). orb-family-sistema → orb-tool-privacidad → /privacy (privacy-screen, privacy-card). PulseCard: privacy-switch-camera toggle updates privacy-row-camera to '→ Grupo 1 · hasta revocar'; privacy-card-flip shows session-row + 15 history-row entries; privacy-card-flip-back returns to front. New-user onboarding end-to-end works: terms→data→transparency→security→account (register), consent screen has 14 consent-row-*, avatar-color-0..6 and avatar-symbol-<pin|shield|car|star|heart> testIDs all present (fix #5 confirmed), add-member-sheet fully fits within 390x844 with membership-temporary+duration-72+channel-sms+add-member-submit all reachable without scrolling (fix #3 confirmed), gray orbital-member-* appears in orbital-field, tapping opens member-sheet with member-status-pill='A la espera de confirmación'. Location banner has been moved to top (location-permission-banner) with location-later/location-request; does not overlap the sentinel-orb. No red screens or React Native errors. Iteration_1 add-member-sheet, avatar picker, and orb-tool overlap issues are all RESOLVED.

minor.issue: Requires Bearer auth; returns 401 'Sesión no iniciada' when unauthenticated. Not documented in spec but reasonable. If spec intends this to be a public endpoint for pre-login, expose via a separate anonymous version. Otherwise no action.

issues: There are TWO permission surfaces on /map for the same intent: (a) a slim top banner 'Permiso de ubicación pendiente' (location-permission-banner) and (b) a large bottom sheet 'Permiso de ubicación del dispositivo' with Permitir/Ahora no. Consider showing only one at a time to avoid redundancy.

action_items: Optional: consolidate the two 'permiso de ubicación' UIs on /map — the top banner + the bottom sheet convey the same message.

Optional: for orb→tool navigation robustness on web, add a very small delay (or use requestAnimationFrame) between close() and onTool() in Orb.tsx onNodePress to avoid a race that can rarely cancel router.push (observed once during the test run before adding a settle-wait). Not blocking — router.push does fire; retry succeeded on first attempt when a 800ms settle wait preceded the tap.
critical_code_review_comments: Orb.tsx:76 calls close() (setOpen(false)) synchronously before onTool(). On web, this triggers the Animated FadeOut before router.push; not a bug but consider swapping order (onTool first, then close) so the exit animation runs after navigation is queued.

map.tsx:58 sets locBanner from an effect; the app then renders a top banner AND the fullscreen 'Permiso de ubicación del dispositivo' sheet — two surfaces controlling the same intent. Consider a single-source-of-truth boolean.
seed_data_creation: Registered two temporary users test_ret_*@sentinelfamily.app (TEST_ prefixed profile/name). Created temporary invitation 'TEST_Invitee' via add-member sheet. No manual DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 backend spec checks pass with real Azure Maps data. Location permission UI on /map has both a top banner and a bottom sheet — click either 'Ahora no' (data-testid='location-later') or dismiss the banner before interacting with orb tools; the bottom sheet does NOT overlap sentinel-orb anymore. For orb→tool taps, wait 800ms after tapping a family node so the physics simulation settles before tapping the tool. Register-only endpoints reject reserved TLDs (.test, .local); use @sentinelfamily.app.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
